{{Quote|Is it possible to learn this power?''"<br />"''Not from a Jedi.|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]|<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref>}}
'''Midi-chlorian manipulation''' was a form of [[Force power/Legends|Force power]] mastered by [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]]. Requiring immense knowledge of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]], it was the ability to create, maintain, or save life through the influencing of [[Midi-chlorian/Legends|midi-chlorians]] to a certain degree. It was said that it was very difficult for a new practitioner of the power to use it, since Plagueis argued that the Force would only accept being directed in this way by a worthy Sith Lord who could hold the weight of authority over life.<ref name="DPN" /> [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] told [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] that Plagueis used this power to save the ones he cared from dying.<ref name="ROTS" /> Indeed, Plagueis was able to use this ability to make creatures give birth without a second partner, referred to by his droid servant [[11-4D/Legends|11-4D]] as the Magister's "pregnancies". Plagueis testing his abilities found he was able to bypass the defense the normally inherent immunity to [[Telepathy/Legends|telepathic]] defenses of a Yinchorri by manipulating the midi-chlorians that under normal circumstances protect a Yinchorri from all forms of telepathic influence. Plagueis was able to kill the comatose [[Darth Venamis]] and then bring him back to life several times, before the [[Bith/Legends|Bith's]] organs failed, and Plagueis granted him everlasting death. In addition, he turned this power on himself, in order to heal his many injuries afforded to him by the [[Maladian]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] who almost killed him in [[52 BBY/Legends|52 BBY]], and was confident that he would stop aging at all with this power. He had also used this ability as a form of execution against the [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] King, [[Ars Veruna/Legends|Ars Veruna]], who carried out a [[Bombing of Sojourn|failed attempt]] to assassinate the Muun Sith Lord; Plagueis had tasked the limited amount of midi-chlorians within the corrupt monarch to return to its source, killing Veruna . However, despite all this, Plagueis was still unable to keep himself from dying at the hands of his apprentice.<ref name="DPN" />

Darth Plagueis stated that a child born of this power would be the embodiment of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. The [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] tried to impose his will on the Force into creating a Forceful being, but considered this a failure, as Anakin Skywalker was created by the Force itself to bring an end to the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] once and for all.<ref name="DPN" /> Later, Palpatine used the promise of this power's effects to entice Anakin Skywalker further to the dark side.<ref name="ROTS" /> He had also made the same proposition to [[Ferus Olin]], telling him that he would teach him powers to defeat Darth Vader and the power over life and death.<ref name="TLOTJSW">''[[The Last of the Jedi: Secret Weapon]]''</ref> However, he was unable to fully master the ability prior to slaying Plagueis, forcing him<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> to [[essence transfer]] into [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] of himself.<ref name="DE2">[[Dark Empire 2|''Dark Empire'' 2]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I used the power of the Force to will the midichlorians to start the cell divisions that created you.''"<br />"''I don't believe you.''"<br />"''Ahhh, but you know it's true. When you clear your mind, you will sense the truth. You could almost think me as your father.''"<br />"''That's impossible!|Palpatine and Anakin Skywalker in a scene from the rough draft of [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith]]|<ref name="MOSWROTS">''[[The Making of Star Wars Revenge of the Sith]]''</ref>}}
The concept of Midi-chlorian Manipulation appeared in [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|Revenge of the Sith]], in form of a story that Palpatine tells Anakin Skywalker in order to seduce him to the Dark side. The story speaks of a Dark Lord of the Sith, [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]], who was allegedly able to create life and defeat death by manipulating midi-chlorians.<ref name="ROTS" /> In the rough draft of the film, Palpatine reveals himself to be responsible for Anakin's mysterious birth in the process.<ref name="MOSWROTS" /> Despite [[George Lucas]] having scrapped the scene, the idea that the Chosen One may have been actually the result of [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]]' experiments became a popular theory among fans. The [[2012]] [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] novel [[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']] combined the presented interpretations of Skywalker's birth stating that [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Plagueis]] was indirectly responsible for [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin's]] creation yet [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] conceived Anakin as a way to stop the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]].<ref name="DPN" /> Lucas himself initially said the mystery of the Chosen One's birth is up to the audience to interpret, since it bears no relevance to the outcome of the events.<ref name="Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith">Featurette "The Chosen One," [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']] DVD</ref> However, in the interview given to [[Paul Duncan]], author of the book ''[[The Star Wars Archives: Episodes I–III, 1999–2005|Star Wars Archives: Episodes I-III, 1999-2005]]'' he clearly stated that Anakin was created by the Will of the Force by the midi-chlorians, verifying the circumstances of Anakin's birth proposed in [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|Episode I]]. Lucas also stated that the legend of Darth Plagueis' abilities was a lie.<ref name="The Star Wars Archives: Episodes I–III, 1999–2005">''[[The Star Wars Archives: Episodes I–III, 1999–2005]]''</ref>

This ability bears resemblance to the real-world alchemic concoction called the [[Wikipedia:Elixir of life|elixir of life]], which was said to grant the drinker eternal life and/or eternal youth, and create new life.
